name: omarchy-store
author: PrometheusRoot
description: An app store for Omarchy plugins with commit-bound safety verdicts: browse, install pinned to the reviewed commit, and a bar shield tinted by the worst state of what you run, from one signed snapshot checked locally. Independent community project, not affiliated with Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Shield tinted by the worst state of your installed plugins; click for the store, right click for the verdict list.
